name: Percheron Therapeutics Limited
summary: Percheron Therapeutics Limited, formerly Antisense Therapeutics Limited, is an Australian company established in 2000 and headquartered in Melbourne that researches and develops antisense pharmaceuticals. Its portfolio includes ATL1102, an antisense inhibitor of CD49d in Phase IIa trials for inflammatory and muscular conditions such as Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy.
